correctness.rationale: Four sign symmetries reduce arbitrary Euclidean pullbacks to r x²+y². With t=|x|^(3/2), its full sphere profile is F_r(t)=r t^(4/3)+(1-t)^(2/3). The exact stationary equation t(1-t)=1/(8r³) has no roots for r<2^(-1/3), or two roots u,1-u otherwise, and extrema m_c=(2-u)/(2(1-u)^(1/3)), M_c=(1+u)/(2u^(1/3)). Endpoint and critical contacts give three monotonic regimes; the minimum occurs when m_c(u)=r, giving u=z³, z³+z²+z-1=0 and d_BM²=(1+z³)(1-z³)^(1/3). A nonzero cross term worsens one signed maximizing value while an axis minimum remains, proving uniqueness. Numerical minimax/cubic residual cross-checks are supplementary.
